title: LibreOffice can import EMF, EMF+ and WMF images, which may be embedded in documents. (CVE-2026-18566)
description: LibreOffice contains a vulnerability in its import functionality for EMF, EMF+, and WMF image formats embedded in documents. The flaw involves several out-of-bounds reads due to unchecked sizes, counts, and offsets in crafted images. This can lead to memory safety issues when processing maliciously crafted images. The issue has been addressed in fixed versions by adding checks against record sizes and remaining data, discarding invalid records.
